extracted.intended_audience: in-house counsel, corporate executives, and companies seeking patent litigation representation
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and implicit selection/evaluation criteria for choosing a patent litigation practice, describing practice capabilities, services offered, jurisdictional reach, and demonstrated outcomes. Useful for clients evaluating law firms for patent enforcement or defense.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enforcement and Defense capability
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to both assert patents on behalf of clients and defend against infringement claims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unlike many firms that focus primarily on defense work, the firm states it has successfully asserted numerous patents and effectively defended against infringement claims; clients benefit from having both enforcement and defense capabilities available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrated patent prosecution and litigation advantage
rubrics_metrics.description: Experience in patent prosecution that bolsters litigation effectiveness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deep experience helping clients secure patents through a renowned patent prosecution practice gives clients an advantage when pursuing enforcement or defense.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical and specialized personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: Team composition including engineers, computer scientists, Ph.D.’s, former patent office examiners, and judicial law clerks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presence of technical experts and former examiners/judicial clerks is presented as strengthening litigation teams across nearly every technology type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tailored litigation strategy aligned with business objectives
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to craft litigation approaches ranging from aggressive litigation to strategies focused on efficient resolution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Firm tailors strategies 'from all-out war to leveraging results for an efficient resolution' depending on client business objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic presence in key patent-litigation forums
rubrics_metrics.description: Offices in geographic areas important for patent litigation (e.g., San Francisco Bay area, Southern California, Seattle, New York, Washington, DC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Having offices in key jurisdictions is cited as part of delivering litigation services and local strategic presence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Experience before the U.S. International Trade Commission (ITC) / Section 337
rubrics_metrics.description: Advocacy experience in ITC investigations which can seek import bans in Section 337 proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ITC is characterized as a fast-paced forum that enforces import bans against infringing products; firm highlights extensive experience in Section 337 investigations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multi‑forum and cross‑border litigation capability
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to handle enforcement and defense across multiple forums and countries (e.g., U.S., UK, Germany) through coordinated strategies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Firm handles multi-forum litigation and coordinates strategies for enforcement cases in multiple jurisdictions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-Litigation Counseling
rubrics_metrics.description: Advisory work before filing suit to evaluate options and risks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed among core services: pre-litigation counseling to shape strategy before taking formal action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Infringement Analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessing whether a product or activity infringes asserted patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included as a discrete service to evaluate infringement exposure and merits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Validity Analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluating the strength and validity of asserted patents (e.g., prior art, claim scope).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Validity analysis is offered to inform enforcement or defense decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cease and Desist Letters
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparation and delivery of cease-and-desist communications as an initial enforcement step.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of pre-filing enforcement toolkit; used to demand cessation of infringing conduct or to support settlement negotiations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lawsuit Filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparation and initiation of patent infringement litigation in court.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Service includes filing suits where appropriate to advance client objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discovery and Evidence Gathering
rubrics_metrics.description: Managing discovery processes and collecting evidence to support infringement or invalidity theories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Essential litigation-phase capability; listed explicitly among services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expert Witness Services
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing or coordinating expert witnesses for technical and damages testimony.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expert witness support is provided as part of building case record and proving damages or technical issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claim Construction
rubrics_metrics.description: Drafting and arguing claim construction positions to define the scope of patent claims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Claim construction is a highlighted litigation activity, central to infringement and validity disputes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Settlement Negotiations
rubrics_metrics.description: Negotiating resolutions and settlements as an alternative to trial.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Settlement negotiation is presented as a core service, consistent with tailoring strategy to business objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Litigation Strategy and Trial Preparation
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing overall litigation plans and preparing for trial.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes trial readiness and tactical planning to support courtroom success or leverage in settlement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Courtroom Representation
rubrics_metrics.description: Direct advocacy and representation of clients in trial and hearings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Firm emphasizes courtroom capability as part of comprehensive litigation services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeals
rubrics_metrics.description: Handling appeals following adverse trial or post-trial rulings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appellate practice is included to pursue or defend appellate review of decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: International patent litigation services
rubrics_metrics.description: Handling patent disputes that have international components, including coordination across jurisdictions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed both as a service and evidenced by multi-jurisdictional case work (e.g., enforcement in U.S., UK, Germany).

rubrics_metrics.name: Industry recognition and rankings
rubrics_metrics.description: National and regional rankings and awards for patent litigation and related IP practices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Firm cites multiple recognitions (e.g., Tier 1 Nationwide for Litigation, IP STARS, Benchmark Litigation, IAM Patent 1000, Legal 500, LMG Life Sciences, BTI Litigation Outlook) as indicators of quality and reputation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Representative case outcomes and demonstrated results
rubrics_metrics.description: Track record of significant verdicts, settlements, invalidity rulings, ITC outcomes, summary judgment wins, and favorable dispositions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include a $466M jury verdict for lost-profits (Masimo v. Philips), obtaining judgments of invalidity on multiple patents (Amazon case), favorable ITC evidentiary rulings leading to termination, summary judgment of non-infringement, and favorable Hatch-Waxman dispositions; used to demonstrate practical success across dispute types.
